rows.text: The Court of Appeal's judgment of 16 September 2015 (AC 9 of 2015) states at paragraph [4]: 'Mr. Pohiva brings his claim on behalf of an unincorporated body, the Friendly Islands Democratic Party, but accepts a personal liability for costs if he is unsuccessful', and adds that he maintains in an affidavit that he is also suing in his personal capacity.
rows.locator: PDF page 1 (Date of Judgment) and page 3 (paragraph [4])
rows.uncertainty: A judicial description of how the claim was brought, not a finding on the party's constitution, registration or officers, and not a registry record. It names no party office for Mr Pohiva; suing on the party's behalf is not treated as leadership. The name 'Friendly Islands Democratic Party' differs in word order from 'Democratic Party of the Friendly Islands'; identity with to_dpfi is not established here.

rows.uncertainty: Describes the respondent's argument in the Supreme Court; the Court of Appeal makes no finding on the party's funds, membership or officers, and the party is not named in this paragraph.
